Class WayangConfig

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.schema.WayangConfig
public class WayangConfig extends Object
WayangConfig — Global configuration for a WayangDefinition.

Consolidates workflow-level config, error handling, resilience patterns, and custom extension configuration into a single object.
